description: This file defines structures, enums, and functions related to handling GeneralNames in X.509 certificates, including parsing and representation of various name types such as DNS, IP addresses, URIs, and other name forms, following RFC 5280.

classes.name: net::GeneralNames
classes.description: Represents a collection of general names from a certificate, including various name types and parsing logic.

methods.name: net::GeneralNames::Create
methods.description: Creates a GeneralNames object from DER-encoded data, referencing the input buffer.

methods.name: net::GeneralNames::CreateFromValue
methods.description: Creates a GeneralNames object from a DER-encoded sequence value.

methods.name: net::ParseGeneralName
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded GeneralName and adds it to a GeneralNames object, with configurable IP address parsing.
